title: How is a file made?
question: open() with O_CREAT makes a file that is not there. What does the kernel make? (In memory: ramfs.)
text: Call 1, [fd = openat(AT_FDCWD, "/new.txt", O_CREAT | O_WRONLY, 0644)](1): [lookup_open](1:lookup_open) The name is not there, and O_CREAT: make the file. [ramfs_mknod](1:ramfs_mknod) ramfs makes it: a new inode (the file itself: its mode, its size, its pages), and the name, a dentry, pointing to it.
